sources.label: A collection of font-related Morphe patches to improve readability/accessibility
sources.author: Stylus
patch_list: Replaces the bundled DM Sans UI fonts with your own font.
Replaces the bundled Roboto Mono font with your own monospace font.
Uses the device's system font for UI text. Monospace text keeps its bundled font.

sources.label: Personal patches for use with Morphe (Bitwarden: no-screen-lock passkey)
sources.author: Aayy
patch_list: Skips the master password / PIN prompt for Bitwarden passkey sign-in and creation on a device with no secure lock screen. Devices with a PIN, pattern, password, or biometric lock are unchanged.
Skips the master password / PIN prompt for Bitwarden passkey sign-in and creation on a device with no secure lock screen. Devices with a PIN, pattern, password, or biometric lock are unchanged.

Lets you trust a Morphe-patched (re-signed) browser for passkeys. Normally Bitwarden hard-fails such a browser with "signature does not match" and offers no way to trust it; this routes it to the standard "trust this browser?" prompt inste…
